article.title: Lula’s Comeback: Gen Z, Short-Form Video, and the Digital Political Reversal
article.author: Sit Tsui
article.content: The "Lula Army" inherited the Brazilian left's longstanding legacy of grassroots street mobilization while waging fierce competition for influence within digital spaces.
